Nessa reads it and goes very quiet. "Front page," she says. The quill gets bored halfway and starts improving the chair's answers. Nothing is printable. The quill sulks in the WILL NOT PRINT basket until your next front page. Prepare all night first You go in tired and over-prepared, with every question written out. The quill follows your lead all the way through. Nessa reads the transcript twice. "Front page." All night's preparation, and the chair simply doesn't turn up.
